n56970d7ccb.headline: Rwanda: What
n56970d7ccb.summary: Rwanda's corporate bond market recorded strong growth in the 2024/2025 fiscal year, with issuance up 61%, particularly green and sustainability-linked bonds.
n56970d7ccb.why: Growth in local corporate bond markets gives companies alternative funding to bank loans and deepens domestic capital markets for investors.

n4a06c00dc2.headline: Lidl reveals plans to open 19 new stores across the UK in the next 8 weeks
n4a06c00dc2.summary: Lidl plans to open 19 new stores across the UK in the next eight weeks as part of its continued expansion in the country.
n4a06c00dc2.why: Lidl is a German discount grocer competing with UK supermarkets such as Tesco and Aldi, so its store rollout signals intensifying price competition in grocery retail.

n42296ba412.headline: Nigeria to revise inflation reporting after artificial spike expected in December
n42296ba412.summary: Nigeria's National Bureau of Statistics will change how it calculates inflation, as last year's rebasing could make December's year-on-year inflation appear artificially high, the agency said.
n42296ba412.why: Inflation data drives central bank policy and bond pricing in Nigeria. Methodology changes affect how investors read the country's price trends.

n500ea00588.headline: North American Morning Briefing :  U.S. Futures Point to Gains As Iran Tensions Ease -2-
n500ea00588.summary: US futures pointed to gains as Iran tensions eased. A US visa issuance pause for permanent immigration routes was also reported, starting January 21.
n500ea00588.why: US equity futures reflect expectations for the S&P 500 before the cash session opens. Geopolitical tensions in the Middle East can move oil prices and risk appetite.
n500ea00588.why_moved: Futures pointed higher as tensions involving Iran eased, improving risk sentiment ahead of the US session.

n2ed6bf95ca.headline: Athens Stock Exchange: Slight Gain Amid Mixed European Trend
n2ed6bf95ca.summary: The Athens Stock Exchange posted a marginal gain while European markets traded mixed. Strong tech earnings and investor caution shaped the session.
n2ed6bf95ca.why: The Athens Stock Exchange is Greece's main equity market. Its benchmark reflects domestic banks and large companies and is sensitive to European risk sentiment.

ncbab709691.headline: Bye, treaty shopping, yeh Tiger zinda hai
ncbab709691.summary: The Supreme Court has ruled that Tiger Global must fulfil its tax liabilities from the sale of its Flipkart shares. The decision allows authorities to examine the intent behind investment structures.
ncbab709691.why: Tiger Global is a US-based investment firm that invested heavily in Indian technology companies. The ruling affects how tax authorities treat foreign investors using intermediary investment structures.

n35b005482d.headline: PM pledges help for flooded graziers 'doing it tough'
n35b005482d.summary: Prime Minister Anthony Albanese has increased financial support for outback communities hit by floods. An ex-tropical cyclone is threatening further damage.
n35b005482d.why: Flood damage to cattle grazing operations affects regional agricultural output and red meat supply. Government relief packages can offset losses for rural producers.

n92d9c83963.headline: As Iran Protests Grow, US Works to Isolate Regime and Pressure China
n92d9c83963.summary: Mass protests and reported killings in Iran coincide with sweeping US tariffs designed to isolate Tehran and pressure Beijing, its main backer. The measures aim to increase economic pressure.
n92d9c83963.why: US tariffs on China affect global trade flows and supply chains. Iran is a major oil producer subject to US sanctions.

n5dd4dfbc33.headline: Ringgit ends lower as firmer US dollar weighs on market
n5dd4dfbc33.summary: The ringgit ended lower as the US dollar rose against major currencies after news that Donald Trump does not intend to replace the current Federal Reserve chairman.
n5dd4dfbc33.why: The ringgit is Malaysia's currency, and it is sensitive to US dollar moves and Federal Reserve policy expectations.
n5dd4dfbc33.why_moved: The US dollar rose against major currencies after news that Trump does not intend to replace the current Federal Reserve chairman, weighing on the ringgit.

nbd1e3c42f3.headline: North American Morning Briefing :  U.S. Futures Point to Gains As Iran Tensions Ease
nbd1e3c42f3.summary: US stock futures pointed to a higher open after concerns over valuations and additional regulation hit tech names on Wednesday. Easing Iran tensions supported Thursday's share optimism.
nbd1e3c42f3.why: S&P 500 futures track expectations for the US equity market's opening, and geopolitical tensions in the Middle East can affect oil prices and risk appetite.
nbd1e3c42f3.why_moved: Futures pointed higher after tech shares fell on valuation and regulation worries the previous day, and tensions involving Iran eased.

n71ae590a87.headline: IMF's Georgieva expects board meeting in weeks on $8.1 billion program for Kiev
n71ae590a87.summary: IMF chief Kristalina Georgieva made a surprise visit to Kyiv and told Reuters she expects to send a new $8.1 billion program to the board within weeks. The visit followed meetings with top Ukrainian officials.
n71ae590a87.why: The IMF provides balance-of-payments financing and policy conditions to member countries, and its programs can unlock other official and private funding.

nde9abe02be.headline: Google now prioritising Youtube and X over publishers on Discover
nde9abe02be.summary: Google is increasingly prioritising X posts, AI summaries and YouTube videos over publisher content on its Discover mobile feed.
nde9abe02be.why: Google Discover is a major traffic source for news publishers, so changes to its ranking affect publisher advertising revenue and audience reach.

n762c848349.headline: Bursa ends at intraday high on bargain-hunting in financial heavyweights
n762c848349.summary: The FBM KLCI gained for a fifth straight session as investors continued to deploy capital despite persistent geopolitical uncertainties, according to an analyst.
n762c848349.why: The FBM KLCI is Malaysia's benchmark index of the largest listed companies, and its moves reflect local and regional investor sentiment.

n38cad4b9aa.headline: Athens Bourse Hits 16-Year High, Gains 1.28%
n38cad4b9aa.summary: The Athens Stock Exchange closed at a 16-year high, gaining 1.28% amid strong trading activity and broad market gains.
n38cad4b9aa.why: The Athens Stock Exchange is Greece's main equity market, and its benchmark level reflects the performance of listed Greek banks and companies.

na10f2132b9.headline: ISA threshold
na10f2132b9.summary: The UK government has published its response to a Treasury Committee report on cash ISAs, the tax-free savings accounts.
na10f2132b9.why: Cash ISA rules affect household savings flows and competition between banks for deposits.

nbf8d874b8e.headline: EMEA Morning Briefing :  Oil Falls After Trump Cools Iran Tensions
nbf8d874b8e.summary: Oil prices fell after US President Donald Trump cooled tensions with Iran, according to the market briefing. European markets were also tracking trade and GDP data and company updates.
nbf8d874b8e.why: Brent crude is the main global oil benchmark, so changes in Middle East tensions and supply expectations feed directly into energy costs, inflation and energy-sector equities.
nbf8d874b8e.why_moved: Trump's comments cooling Iran tensions reduced the geopolitical risk premium in oil, so prices fell.

nc84572987e.headline: South Indian Bank rides the banking recovery wave: Q3 net profit, asset quality improve
nc84572987e.summary: South Indian Bank reported a 9.5% rise in third-quarter net profit, and its gross non-performing asset ratio fell to 2.67%.
nc84572987e.why: South Indian Bank is a listed private lender in India, and falling bad-loan ratios indicate improving credit quality in its loan book.

n54d0632621.headline: NZX50 slips as mood sours on tech
n54d0632621.summary: New Zealand's S&P/NZX 50 index fell as souring sentiment on tech stocks weighed on Infratil, Serko, Vista Group and Gentrack. Asian technology firms were on edge ahead of TSMC earnings.
n54d0632621.why: The S&P/NZX 50 is New Zealand's benchmark index of its largest listed companies, and Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co. is the world's largest contract chipmaker.

n2a9e9bcdb3.headline: OMV expects multimillion-dollar fourth quarter impairments
n2a9e9bcdb3.summary: OMV expects multimillion-dollar impairments in the fourth quarter, and also forecasts lower hydrocarbon production and lower realised oil and gas prices versus the previous quarter.
n2a9e9bcdb3.why: OMV is an Austrian integrated oil and gas company, so its production and impairment guidance reflects broader energy price and upstream output trends.

n6142003769.headline: Trump Sees Iranian Crackdown Easing, Tehran Denies Man to Be Executed
n6142003769.summary: US President Donald Trump said he was told killings in Iran's crackdown were easing and that no large-scale executions were currently planned. Iranian state media reported a man arrested during the protests was to be executed.
n6142003769.why: US policy toward Iran, a major oil producer, shapes sanctions risk and geopolitical premiums in energy markets.

n994d64a45a.headline: US sanctions Iranian officials accused of repressing protests against government
n994d64a45a.summary: The US is imposing a new round of sanctions on Iranian officials accused of repressing nationwide protests that challenge Iran's theocratic government. The measures target officials over the crackdown.
n994d64a45a.why: Sanctions restrict access to US finance and trade for designated individuals and can affect firms that deal with them.

ne5a2e21c12.headline: US Treasury: Tehran Leaders Transfer Massive Funds Out of Iran
ne5a2e21c12.summary: The US Treasury has raised concerns about Tehran's leadership transferring substantial funds out of Iran, drawing discussion of possible secondary tariffs on Iranian exports.
ne5a2e21c12.why: Secondary tariffs and financial sanctions can restrict trade with third countries and affect global commodity and currency flows.

ne7de8b3084.headline: The two Venezuelan women vying for Trump's support to lead the country
ne7de8b3084.summary: Venezuela's political future is described as highly uncertain, with its destiny divided between two prominent women seeking support from the Trump administration.
ne7de8b3084.why: Venezuela's political direction shapes the outlook for its oil sector and sanctions, which matter for global crude supply and investors in Venezuelan debt.

n94f6c881a5.headline: Global trade finance gap at $2.5 trillion as global trade tensions rise, ADB says
n94f6c881a5.summary: The Asian Development Bank says financial institutions globally failed to meet $2.5 trillion in trade financing needed by companies, as trade tensions rise.
n94f6c881a5.why: The Asian Development Bank is a multilateral lender, and trade finance gaps restrict companies' ability to fund cross-border shipments.

n230d3e863a.headline: TSMC smashes forecasts with record profit, flags more U.S. factories
n230d3e863a.summary: TSMC posted fourth-quarter profit that beat forecasts, rising 35% to $16 billion as the AI boom continued. The chipmaker also flagged more factories in the United States.
n230d3e863a.why: TSMC is the world's largest contract manufacturer of advanced chips, supplying major AI and technology companies.
n230d3e863a.why_moved: Quarterly profit rose 35% to $16 billion, above forecasts, as AI demand continued. The company also flagged additional US factories.

n9123b8b60e.headline: Recto, Ledesma face plunder, graft complaints over PhilHealth fund transfer
n9123b8b60e.summary: Executive Secretary Ralph Recto and Ledesma face plunder and graft complaints over a PhilHealth fund transfer. Recto says he respects the right to seek legal remedies and maintains his innocence.
n9123b8b60e.why: PhilHealth is the Philippines' state health insurance agency, and fund transfers involving it draw scrutiny over public finances.

n182d849b4d.headline: BOJ to raise rates again to 1% or higher by end-September, possibly by July:  Reuters Poll
n182d849b4d.summary: A Reuters poll finds economists expect the Bank of Japan to wait until July before its next rate hike. More than 75% expect the policy rate at 1% or higher by September.
n182d849b4d.why: The Bank of Japan sets the country's key short-term interest rate, which influences the yen, Japanese government bond yields and global carry trades.

neab4b88336.headline: TSMC Q4 profit jumps 35% to record, beats expectations
neab4b88336.summary: TSMC posted a 35% jump in fourth-quarter net profit, beating market forecasts and reaching a record. The company benefited from surging demand, according to the report.
neab4b88336.why: TSMC is the world's largest contract chipmaker, producing advanced semiconductors for companies such as Apple and Nvidia, so its results are a bellwether for the chip sector.
neab4b88336.why_moved: Quarterly profit rose 35% to a record and beat market forecasts, a result that tends to lift the shares of the company and chip-sector peers.

n745cfe73a0.headline: Alberta Advances Regulatory Changes to Facilitate Data Centre Development
n745cfe73a0.summary: Alberta's Bills 8 and 12 reshape data centre regulation, grid access and levies, supporting AI growth while aiming to protect grid stability and affordability.
n745cfe73a0.why: Data centres drive demand for power and computing capacity, so rules on grid access and levies affect the cost and feasibility of AI infrastructure investment.

ncaa320ce4c.headline: Why Is a Fed Official Visiting Athens?
ncaa320ce4c.summary: An unexpected visit by a senior Federal Reserve official to Athens raises questions about Greece's role in global monetary politics and transatlantic relations.
ncaa320ce4c.why: Greece's economic and geopolitical position in Europe makes such visits significant for monetary policy and international finance discussions.

nd852aad4be.headline: The “scream test” and the art of counting to one: How DSV is merging two huge IT departments after historic acquisition worth billions
nd852aad4be.summary: Following its acquisition of DB Schenker, DSV is integrating 1,200 IT systems and seven data centers to unify operations.
nd852aad4be.why: DSV is a global logistics company; successful IT integration is critical to realizing synergies and operational efficiencies post-acquisition.

impacts.why: Integration of IT systems is key to acquisition success and cost savings.
